nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances per address used as the source of truth for token ownership.
Declared token balance mapping (unused in the implemented logic).
ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Mapping marking addresses exempt from buy/sell fees.
Mapping of addresses blacklisted by the owner from transferring.
Total reflection supply, reduced on every fee reflection.
Accumulated token fees collected through reflections.
Tax rate slot 1 used when computing transfer values (set to 0).
Tax rate slot 2 holding buy or sell tax applied to transfers.
Sell tax percentage applied when sending to the liquidity pair.
Buy tax percentage applied when buying from the liquidity pair.
Payable treasury address receiving ETH from swap proceeds.
Uniswap V2 router address used for swaps and liquidity.
Liquidity pair address for CINU/WETH.
Flag indicating whether trading has been opened.
Reentrancy guard flag set while swapping/burning.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token swapping.
Flag controlling whether the max transaction amount is enforced.
Maximum amount of tokens that may be transferred in a single transaction.
Owner address used by the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
Private _transfer: core routing function that checks bot/exclusion status, applies taxes, burns tokens, swaps for ETH and sends ETH to the fee address.
Private _tokenTransfer: thin wrapper delegating to _transferStandard.
Private _transferStandard: mutates _rOwned balances, takes team fee and reflects the fee.
Private swapTokensForEth: approves the router and swaps contract tokens for ETH using block.timestamp as deadline.
Private sendETHToFee: forwards the contract ETH balance to the fee address via transfer.
Private burnToken: guarded by lockTheSwap, transfers tokens to the dead address.
Owner-only createPair: sets the router and creates the Uniswap pair.
Owner-only openTrading: approves router, adds liquidity, enables swapping and sets the max tx amount.
Owner-only manualswap: swaps the full contract token balance for ETH.
Owner-only manualsend: sends the whole contract ETH balance to the fee address.
Owner-only _setMaxTxAmount: updates the max transaction amount with an arithmetic threshold check.
Owner-only setRemoveMaxTx: toggles the removeMaxTx flag.
Owner-only setBots: blacklists an array of addresses in a loop.
Public ERC20 transfer: forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens and decrements the allowance using SafeMath.sub.
Owner-only setBuyTax: lowers the buy tax below the 12 percent cap.
Owner-only _setSellTax: lowers the sell tax below the 12 percent cap.
Private _getRate: computes rSupply/tSupply reflection rate.
Private _getCurrentSupply: returns reflection and token supplies with a division based sanity check.
Private tokenFromReflection: converts a reflection amount into a token amount using the current rate.
msg.sender, used for caller identity in transfer/approve paths and onlyOwner checks.
block.timestamp, used as the swap/liquidity deadline.
_feeAddress.transfer(amount): external ETH value transfer that can execute recipient code and reenter.
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens: external call to an untrusted router/pair.
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH with a user supplied deadline: external value-bearing call.
IUniswapV2Factory.createPair: external call creating the trading pair.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as sender into the internal _transfer from the public transfer entry point.
msg.sender is used as the spender when decrementing the allowance in transferFrom.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner, so msg.sender controls setRemoveMaxTx execution.
onlyOwner gates _setMaxTxAmount on msg.sender equality with _owner.
onlyOwner gates setBots on msg.sender equality with _owner.
onlyOwner gates setBuyTax on msg.sender equality with _owner.
onlyOwner gates _setSellTax on msg.sender equality with _owner.
onlyOwner gates createPair on msg.sender equality with _owner.
onlyOwner gates openTrading on msg.sender equality with _owner.
onlyOwner gates manualswap on msg.sender equality with _owner.
onlyOwner gates manualsend on msg.sender equality with _owner.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline of swapTokensForEth, making execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline during openTrading.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount and adds rTransferAmount to _rOwned.
_transferStandard reflects the fee, updating _tFeeTotal through _reflectFee.
_transfer reads _sellTax to set the fee address slot on sells.
_transfer reads _buyTax to set the fee address slot on buys.
_transfer conditionally enforces _maxTxAmount based on the removeMaxTx flag.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before performing the automatic swap.
_transfer compares the receiver balance plus amount against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer requires !bots[from], reading the blacklist mapping.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether taxes apply.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for each supplied address.
setRemoveMaxTx writes the onoff flag into removeMaxTx.
_setMaxTxAmount performs the 20000000 * 10**9 comparison and writes _maxTxAmount.
setBuyTax writes the validated value into _buyTax.
_setSellTax writes the validated value into _sellTax.
createPair assigns the Uniswap router instance to uniswapV2Router.
createPair assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
openTrading sets removeMaxTx to true.
burnToken uses the lockTheSwap modifier, toggling inSwap around the burn.
swapTokensForEth uses the lockTheSwap modifier, toggling inSwap around the swap.
_transfer reads inSwap to avoid recursive swapping.
_getRate computes rSupply.div(tSupply) into the currentRate local.
Public transfer calls the internal _transfer with msg.sender as the sender.
transferFrom calls _transfer before updating the allowance.
_transfer delegates the balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains values that depend on _getRate.
_transfer calls burnToken on a quarter of the contract token balance.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth on the remaining contract token balance.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which forwards ETH, allowing the recipient to reenter during the transfer flow.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call on the router.
createPair performs an external createPair call on the factory.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap-for-ETH external call.
burnToken routes through the internal _transfer to the dead address.
_getRate obtains rSupply and tSupply from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned by _getRate.
sendETHToFee executes the external ETH transfer to the fee address.
The ETH value transfer can execute recipient fallback code that reenters _transfer before inSwap/state updates settle.
The router/pair external swap call can invoke token callbacks that reenter _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a transient argument of _transfer and carries no standalone security semantics.
to is a transient argument of _transfer consumed only inside the function body.
amount is a local argument of _transfer used for the tax and max-tx arithmetic.
tokenAmount only parameterizes the router swap inside swapTokensForEth.
amount only parameterizes the ETH transfer executed by sendETHToFee.
burnAmount is only used to trigger the dead-address transfer inside burnToken.
maxTxAmount is validated and stored only within _setMaxTxAmount.
onoff is written directly into removeMaxTx by setRemoveMaxTx.
bots_ is iterated only inside setBots to populate the blacklist mapping.
sender is the address whose reflection balance is debited inside _transferStandard.
recipient is the address whose reflection balance is credited inside _transferStandard.
tAmount is the input to the rate/value computation of _transferStandard.
sellTax is bounds-checked and stored only by _setSellTax.
buyTax is bounds-checked and stored only by setBuyTax.
rAmount is the reflection amount converted to tokens inside tokenFromReflection.
amount is the ERC20 value forwarded by the public transfer into _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary balance used to size the burn and swap in _transfer.
burnAmount is the temporary quarter-balance passed to burnToken from _transfer.
path is the transient swap route array built inside swapTokensForEth.
walletBalance is a transient receiver balance used in the max-tx check of _transfer.
currentRate is the transient reflection rate produced by _getRate.
rSupply is a transient reflection supply value local to _getCurrentSupply.
tSupply is a transient token supply value local to _getCurrentSupply.
